# sds270final

<!-- badges: start -->
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/abbyhunt24/sds270project/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/abbyhunt24/sds270project/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)

The `DollyWood` package provides an R interface to retrieve data about [DollyWood rides]("https://www.dollywood.com/themepark/rides/"). 

## Installation

You can install the development version of DollyWood from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("abbyhunt24/sds270project")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

```{r example}
library(sds270final)
## basic example code
```
